covers: JSE session to 13:00 SAST on Friday 13 November 2026; US items are from Thursday's close and Friday-morning headlines
headline: JSE trims its losses by lunchtime as Naspers and Prosus recover part of the morning fall; rand holds near R16.89/$ and gold stays below $3,900
summary: By 13:00 SAST the JSE All Share was at 112,627.12 and the Top 40 at 104,701.63, both about 0.2-0.3% below Thursday's close after a 0.5% dip in the morning, with Naspers now down 1.6% and Prosus 1.3% (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 13 Nov 2026 to 13:00 SAST). The rand was at R16.89/$, 2.5% weaker than a week ago, as the dollar heads for its best week since September on bets of more Fed rate hikes after Thursday's jump in the US 10-year yield to 5.10% (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 6-13 Nov 2026; Investing.com headline, 13 Nov 2026 12:44 SAST). Gold was at $3,894.90, 4.4% lower on the week, and Brent eased to $95.75 from $96.46 this morning, while a long Microsoft outage is weighing on Microsoft shares ahead of US producer prices this afternoon (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 6-13 Nov 2026; CNBC and MarketWatch headlines, 13 Nov 2026).

items.title: Microsoft outage drags on, taking down Outlook and other 365 services; shares under pressure
items.summary: CNBC reports the widespread Microsoft outage is continuing, and MarketWatch reports Microsoft stock dropping as key services stay down. Moneyweb reports the disruption has pushed some traders back to phones and fax. Microsoft closed Thursday at $523.00, up 0.4%, before the outage deepened.
items.source: CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 12:55 SAST; MarketWatch headline, 13 Nov 2026 11:32 SAST; Moneyweb headline, 13 Nov 2026 11:09 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance MSFT), 12 Nov 2026 close

items.title: Nvidia closes 4.3% lower after CEO Jensen Huang resigns
items.summary: Nvidia ended Thursday at $166.19, down 4.3% from Wednesday's $173.70 close, trimming a deeper intraday fall. Colette Kress is interim CEO. CNBC's live coverage reports President Trump calling the episode a 'horrible thing'. Results are still scheduled for 17 November. CNBC reported on Friday that the scandal has drawn in Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, who reportedly agreed to testify about China chip sales.
items.source: CNBC and MarketWatch headlines, 12-13 Nov 2026 (to 04:32 SAST); LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance NVDA), 11-12 Nov 2026 closes; CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 12:54 SAST

items.title: US bond yields post their biggest surge since 2022 on Fed rate-hike fears
items.summary: MarketWatch reports the sharpest jump in Treasury yields since 2022 as markets price more Fed rate hikes. The US 10-year yield closed at 5.10%, up from 4.86% a week earlier.
items.source: MarketWatch headline, 13 Nov 2026 00:16 SAST; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^TNX), 12 Nov 2026 close and 6 Nov 2026 close

items.title: Fed braces for another inflation fight; dollar heads for best week since September
items.summary: CNBC reports the Federal Reserve, which had expected to cut rates this year, is now bracing for another fight against inflation. Investing.com reports the dollar on course for its best week since September, with the yen near 160 per dollar.
items.source: CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 12:00 SAST; Investing.com headline, 13 Nov 2026 12:44 SAST

items.title: JSE trims morning losses: All Share -0.2%, Top 40 -0.3%; Naspers -1.6%, Prosus -1.3%
items.summary: The All Share was at 112,627.12 (Thursday close 112,894.87) and the Top 40 at 104,701.63 (Thursday 104,981.31) at 13:00 SAST, recovering from about -0.5% at 10:59. Naspers was 1.6% lower and Prosus 1.3% lower at 12:45 SAST, from -2.1% and -2.4% earlier. Gold miners stayed weaker: AngloGold Ashanti -1.6%, Gold Fields -0.7%, Harmony -0.5%.
